description: This is a JavaScript source file for a Node.js script that performs analysis and auditing of a code repository, specifically focusing on seam inventory, static leak detection, inter-file dependencies, and related testing inventory. The script imports modules, defines helper functions, and exports main functions to carry out the audit process, generating JSON output.

methods.name: collectWorkspacePackagePaths
methods.description: Collects paths to workspace package.json files, extending initial list with extension directories.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Converts a full file path to a relative path from the repository root, using forward slashes.

methods.name: readScannableText
methods.description: Reads a file's content up to MAX_SCAN_BYTES for analysis, handling large files efficiently.

methods.name: redactNpmSpec
methods.description: Redacts sensitive info from npm spec URLs in dependency declarations.

methods.name: isCodeFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename has a typical source code extension.

methods.name: isTestLikePath
methods.description: Determines if a relative path likely points to a test file.

methods.name: isProductionLikeFile
methods.description: Filters out test files, considering only production code files.

methods.name: walkCodeFiles
methods.description: Recursively finds all production code files under a root directory.

methods.name: walkAllCodeFiles
methods.description: Recursively finds all code files, optionally including test files.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Gets line number from a SourceFile node for error reporting or analysis.

methods.name: resolveRelativeSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves relative import specifiers to absolute paths.

methods.name: normalizePluginSdkFamily
methods.description: Normalizes plugin SDK paths to identify family groups.

methods.name: resolveOptionalClusterFromPath
methods.description: Attempts to determine optional cluster name from a resolved path.

methods.name: compareImports
methods.description: Comparison function for import entries for sorting.

methods.name: collectPluginSdkImports
methods.description: Extracts plugin SDK import/export and dynamic import entries from a source file.

methods.name: collectCorePluginSdkImports
methods.description: Gathers all plugin SDK import information across project files.

methods.name: collectOptionalClusterStaticImports
methods.description: Extracts static import/export entries related to optional clusters.

methods.name: collectOptionalClusterStaticLeaks
methods.description: Gathers static import leaks from source files.

methods.name: buildDuplicatedSeamFamilies
methods.description: Aggregates duplicate seam families imported across multiple files.

methods.name: buildOverlapFiles
methods.description: Identifies files imported from multiple seam families.

methods.name: buildOptionalClusterStaticLeaks
methods.description: Organizes static leak data by optional cluster.

methods.name: packageClusterMeta
methods.description: Infers cluster information from package paths.

methods.name: classifyMissingPackageCluster
methods.description: Decides if a missing package should be required or optional based on context.

methods.name: buildMissingPackages
methods.description: Determines missing dependencies in workspace packages and whether they are required/optional.

methods.name: stemFromRelativePath
methods.description: Removes file extension to produce a base stem for matching.

methods.name: splitNameTokens
methods.description: Splits a name into lowercase tokens for heuristic matching.

methods.name: escapeForRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: hasImportSource
methods.description: Checks if source contains a specific import source pattern.

methods.name: hasAnyImportSource
methods.description: Checks if source imports from any of multiple specified sources.

methods.name: matchQualityRank
methods.description: Assigns heuristic relevance ranks to test matches.

methods.name: findRelatedTests
methods.description: Identifies test files related to a source file based on naming and import heuristics.

methods.name: determineSeamTestStatus
methods.description: Classifies test coverage status for seam candidates based on related tests.

methods.name: buildSeamTestInventory
methods.description: Collects seam candidate info and related tests across project files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function to run audit process and output JSON report.
